observations: Photo 0 shows two headlamp assemblies on a concrete floor, one in the foreground and one partially visible at top right.
The foreground unit has a clear lens, projector-style inner lens, amber indicator section, chrome housing, and mounting ribs at the bottom.
A watermark reading "PUREGOLD GLOBAL" appears across the foreground lens.
Background includes cardboard cartons and blue racking; no brand plate, logo, or part number is readable on either unit.

claims.claim: These are genuine Kia or Hyundai spare parts.
claims.evidence: No logo, part number, or packaging visible in photo 0 to confirm make or genuineness.

claims.claim: The headlight is new or fairly used.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a used-looking unit, but full condition cannot be assessed remotely.

risks.risk: Not a genuine Kia/Hyundai part; may be aftermarket.
risks.proof: Close-up of any embossed brand, part number, or original box.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment for buyer's vehicle model or year.
risks.proof: Part number or compatibility list, or clear photo of rear housing and connector.

risks.risk: Lens cracks, clouding, broken mounting tabs, or internal reflector damage not visible in the still photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photos or video of lens edges, mounting clips, and rear electrical connector.

risks.risk: Headlight does not power on or bulbs/ballasts are faulty.
risks.proof: Video of the unit switched on with low beam, high beam, and indicator.

proof_requests: Close-up of any marking, part number, or logo on the headlight housing.
Photo of the rear of the unit showing connector and mounting points.
Video of the headlight powered on (low beam, high beam, indicator).
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a car headlight assembly from photo 0, so it can be priced at its worst case (non-genuine, wrong fitment, damaged, not working) while awaiting proof.
